0022600230.text: The Charlotte Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road, third in the Southeast and 2.5 games back) visit the Phoenix Suns (4-6, 4-3 at home, 11th in the West) for the Hornets' 12th game of the season, with both teams coming in on a W1 streak. Charlotte is missing Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) and is listing Moussa Diabate as day-to-day with a quadriceps injury and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Hornets winning the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
